tools.name: find_career_experiment
tools.description: Finds a small way to try, test or get a feel for a career, job, trade or field before committing to it, for someone weighing whether to quit, retrain or switch into it, e.g. 'how do I know if I'd like UX design', 'try nursing before going back to school', 'test a career change this weekend', 'is pro

tools.name: explore_career_directions
tools.description: Suggests kinds of work that might suit someone, for questions about what to do with their life or which careers fit their interests, strengths, values or past experience, e.g. 'what jobs suit someone who likes fixing things', 'careers for people who love the outdoors', 'what else can I do with my te

tools.name: check_career_change_facts
tools.description: Answers factual questions about changing jobs or careers, e.g. 'is it too late to change careers at 40', 'is 50 too old to switch careers', 'how many jobs does the average person have in a lifetime', 'how long do people stay with one employer', 'how many different careers are there', 'will AI make m

tools.name: find_career_guide
tools.description: Searches OffLadder's 780 written career guides and returns the closest ones, each with its direct answer, key points, primary sources and a link. Fits a how-to, advice or "what should I do" question about work and careers, e.g. 'how do I tailor my CV to a job description', 'how do I explain a career

tools.name: read_career_guide
tools.description: Returns the full text of one OffLadder career guide as Markdown: the direct answer, key takeaways, every section, worked examples and templates, the questions people also ask, and the sources. tools.name: browse_career_guides
tools.description: Lists every OffLadder career guide on one subject, as questions with links, so someone can see what there is to read before picking one, e.g. 'show me everything on interviews', 'what guides do you have for students', 'reading list for after a layoff', 'what do you have on AI and jobs', 'guides on f

tools.name: get_career_direction
tools.description: Returns everything OffLadder holds on one emerging direction of work: what the days contain, why it is appearing now, what AI changes about it, the human abilities it leans on, the experience it grows out of, one small test and what is still unknown. Without a name, lists all 24 directions by family

tools.name: look_up_job
tools.description: Looks up one named job or profession and returns everything OffLadder has written about it, for someone worried about their own job or weighing one to move into, e.g. 'will AI replace accountants', 'is my job as a paralegal safe from AI', 'will AI take software engineering jobs', 'is graphic design

tools.name: compare_jobs
tools.description: Puts two or three named jobs side by side for someone choosing between them, e.g. 'nursing or teaching', 'should I become an electrician or a plumber', 'data analyst vs software engineer', 'physician assistant vs nurse practitioner', 'UX design or product management', 'accountant vs financial analys

tools.name: browse_jobs
tools.description: Lists the jobs OffLadder has written about in one field of work, for someone who wants ideas or wants to see what exists before choosing one, e.g. 'what jobs are there in healthcare besides being a doctor', 'list careers in tech', 'what trades could I go into', 'creative jobs I could look at', 'publ

tools.name: plan_career_change_runway
tools.description: Works out how many months someone can afford to spend testing or making a career change, from their own numbers, e.g. 'can I afford to quit my job', 'how long can I last without a salary', 'I have 12,000 saved and spend 2,500 a month, how long do I have to change careers', 'how much runway do I need

tools.name: start_my_reading
